# Risk limits and reason codes

Limits: `src/config/limits.py` (`RiskLimits`), set with `RISK_<NAME>` variables; values outside the bounds fail startup (exit 2). Their hash (`limits_hash`) is recorded on every risk decision; the month run's pre-registration pins it.

| Variable | Type | Default | Bounds | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `RISK_RISK_PER_TRADE` | float | 0.02 | > 0, <= 0.05 | Equity at risk per trade |
| `RISK_MAX_POSITION_PCT` | float | 0.1 | > 0, <= 0.25 | Notional cap vs equity |
| `RISK_MAX_POSITION_INR` | float | 100000.0 | > 0 | Notional cap in INR |
| `RISK_ADV_PCT` | float | 0.01 | > 0, <= 0.1 | Order size cap vs 20-day ADV |
| `RISK_KELLY_ENABLED` | bool | False | - | Kelly sizing (only with enough real trades) |
| `RISK_KELLY_MIN_TRADES` | int | 30 | >= 30 | Real net trades before Kelly applies |
| `RISK_KELLY_SCALE` | float | 0.25 | > 0, <= 1.0 | Fraction of full Kelly |
| `RISK_MIN_RR` | float | 1.5 | >= 0.5, <= 10.0 | Minimum reward:risk from the price |
| `RISK_STOP_ATR_MIN` | float | 0.5 | > 0, <= 10.0 | Tightest stop, in ATRs |
| `RISK_STOP_ATR_MAX` | float | 3.0 | > 0, <= 10.0 | Widest stop, in ATRs |
| `RISK_MAX_STOP_PCT` | float | 0.05 | > 0, <= 0.25 | Widest stop vs price |
| `RISK_PRICE_COLLAR_PCT` | float | 0.03 | > 0, <= 0.2 | Decision vs fresh price |
| `RISK_ALLOW_SHORT` | bool | False | - | Opening shorts (never for CNC) |
| `RISK_MAX_POSITIONS` | int | 5 | >= 1, <= 20 | - |
| `RISK_MAX_GROSS_EXPOSURE_PCT` | float | 0.5 | > 0, <= 1.0 | - |
| `RISK_MAX_SECTOR_PCT` | float | 0.3 | > 0, <= 1.0 | - |
| `RISK_MAX_HEAT_PCT` | float | 0.06 | > 0, <= 0.25 | Sum of open risk vs equity |
| `RISK_DAILY_LOSS_LIMIT_PCT` | float | 0.01 | > 0, <= 0.1 | MTM vs start of day |
| `RISK_MAX_DRAWDOWN_PCT` | float | 0.05 | > 0, <= 0.25 | Equity vs running peak |
| `RISK_MAX_ENTRIES_PER_DAY` | int | 10 | >= 1, <= 100 | - |
| `RISK_ENABLED_STRATEGIES` | tuple[str, ...] | ('momentum', 'mean_reversion') | - | Strategies allowed to trade; anything else is shadow-only (plan D8) |
| `RISK_STRATEGY_CAPITAL_PCT` | float | 0.5 | > 0, <= 1.0 | Deployed per strategy |
| `RISK_STRATEGY_DAILY_LOSS_PCT` | float | 0.005 | > 0, <= 0.1 | - |
| `RISK_STRATEGY_MAX_CONSEC_LOSSES` | int | 4 | >= 1, <= 50 | - |
| `RISK_STRATEGY_ORDERS_PER_MIN` | int | 5 | >= 1, <= 60 | - |
| `RISK_MAX_QUOTE_AGE_S` | float | 1200.0 | > 0, <= 3600.0 | Per audit F.0 (YF) |
| `RISK_MAX_OPEN_ORDERS` | int | 20 | >= 1, <= 200 | - |
| `RISK_ORDERS_PER_MIN` | int | 10 | >= 1, <= 120 | Far below SEBI/broker limits |
| `RISK_REJECT_STORM_COUNT` | int | 5 | >= 1, <= 100 | - |
| `RISK_REJECT_STORM_WINDOW_S` | float | 600.0 | > 0, <= 86400.0 | - |
| `RISK_DAILY_LOSS_ACTION` | 'HALT_NEW' \| 'FLATTEN' | 'FLATTEN' | - | - |
| `RISK_DRAWDOWN_ACTION` | 'HALT_NEW' \| 'FLATTEN' | 'FLATTEN' | - | - |
| `RISK_REARM_ON_NEW_DAY` | bool | False | - | Re-arm a daily-loss trip next IST day |
| `RISK_FLATTEN_ESCALATE_AFTER` | int | 3 | >= 1, <= 20 | Attempts before CRITICAL |

## Reason codes

Every blocked or resized order names its codes (`RiskDecision.reasons`). *Pre-trade check*: on entries only, or on every order including exits (exits fail open: only these few can stop one). *Monitor breach*: also raised by the risk monitor's 60-second tick, which trips the kill switches (see `docs/runbooks/kill-switch.md`).

| Code | Level | Pre-trade check | Monitor breach | Message |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ORD_QTY_NONPOS` | order | every order |  | quantity must be positive |
| `ORD_NOTIONAL_MAX` | order | entries |  | position capped at Rs {...} |
| `ORD_RISK_PER_TRADE` | order | entries |  | risk capped at {...} of equity (Rs {...}) over a {...} stop |
| `ORD_STOP_WRONG_SIDE` | order | entries |  | {...} with stop {...} at/through price {...} |
| `ORD_STOP_TOO_WIDE` | order | entries |  | stop too far from the price |
| `ORD_STOP_TOO_TIGHT` | order | entries |  | stop inside the noise |
| `ORD_RR_MIN` | order | entries |  | reward:risk below the minimum at the current price |
| `ORD_PRICE_COLLAR` | order | entries |  | decision price is far from the fresh price |
| `ORD_ADV_PCT` | order | entries |  | order capped at {...} of ADV |
| `ORD_CIRCUIT_BAND` | order | entries |  | at or near the circuit limit |
| `ORD_TICK` | order | every order |  | {...} {...} is off the {...} tick |
| `ORD_SHORT_NOT_ALLOWED` | order | entries |  | opening a short is not allowed (CNC long-only) |
| `ORD_REDUCE_EXCEEDS_POS` | order | every order |  | a reduction never exceeds the position |
| `EVT_RESULTS_WINDOW` | order | entries |  | results {...} on {...} |
| `EVT_ADVERSE_MAJOR` | order | entries |  | negative major event on {...}: {...} |
| `STR_HALTED` | strategy | entries |  | strategy {...} kill switch is {...} |
| `STR_NOT_VALIDATED` | strategy | entries |  | {...} is not enabled for trading (shadow only) |
| `STR_CAPITAL_ALLOC` | strategy | entries |  | {...} allocation room |
| `STR_DAILY_LOSS` | strategy | entries | yes | {...} hit its daily loss limit |
| `STR_CONSEC_LOSSES` | strategy | entries | yes | {...} lost {...} in a row |
| `STR_ORDER_RATE` | strategy | entries |  | {...} order rate too high |
| `PF_MAX_POSITIONS` | portfolio | entries |  | maximum open positions reached |
| `PF_DUPLICATE` | portfolio | entries |  | already holding (or buying) {...} |
| `PF_REENTRY_SAME_DAY` | portfolio | entries |  | {...} already traded today |
| `PF_GROSS` | portfolio | entries |  | gross exposure room |
| `PF_NET` | portfolio | - |  | - |
| `PF_SECTOR` | portfolio | entries |  | sector {...} room |
| `PF_HEAT` | portfolio | entries |  | portfolio heat room |
| `PF_CASH` | portfolio | entries |  | cash available |
| `PF_DAILY_LOSS_MTM` | portfolio | entries | yes | daily loss limit reached (mark-to-market) |
| `PF_DRAWDOWN` | portfolio | entries | yes | drawdown limit reached |
| `PF_ENTRIES_PER_DAY` | portfolio | entries |  | maximum entries for the day reached |
| `SYS_KILL_GLOBAL` | system | entries |  | global kill switch is {...} |
| `SYS_KILL_BROKER` | system | entries |  | broker kill switch is {...} |
| `SYS_SESSION_CLOSED` | system | every order |  | the market is closed |
| `SYS_HOLIDAY` | system | every order |  | exchange holiday |
| `SYS_ENTRY_CUTOFF` | system | entries |  | outside the entry window |
| `SYS_DATA_STALE` | system | entries |  | no quote for the instrument |
| `SYS_DATA_SIMULATED` | system | every order |  | market data source unknown: no orders |
| `SYS_MAX_OPEN_ORDERS` | system | entries |  | too many open orders |
| `SYS_ORDER_RATE` | system | entries |  | order rate limit |
| `SYS_REJECT_STORM` | system | entries | yes | too many recent rejects |
| `SYS_UNKNOWN_ORDER` | system | entries |  | an order in this instrument has an UNKNOWN outcome |
| `SYS_LLM_DEGRADED` | system | entries |  | AI advisor unavailable: the deterministic decision stands |
| `SYS_JOURNAL_NOT_DURABLE` | system | entries |  | the event store is not durable |
| `SYS_RECON_DRIFT` | system | entries |  | the book disagrees with the broker |
| `SYS_CHECK_ERROR` | system | - |  | {...} raised {...}: {...} |
